statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-5932 affects only golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp and its subpackages. The k6 build records its complete production dependency graph in /app/security/k6-packages.txt and fails if any of those packages is imported. x/crypto is used by other, unaffected packages. This statement applies only to k6 with x/crypto v0.57.0; runner and OS findings remain gated normally.
